connector.name: Attestify Os
connector.registryDescription: Governed agent execution: x402 payments, budgets, receipts, verification, and audit.
connector.summary: Hosted at attestify-os.vercel.app over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package attestify-os. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the attestifyagent account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: ATTESTIFY_API_KEY
env.description: Tenant API key issued via POST /api/keys. Optional for discovery, required for governed /api/run calls.
